newsitem.title: USA: ProxyMed Inc sells 600,000 common shares.
newsitem.headline: ProxyMed Inc sells 600,000 common shares.

text.p: ProxyMed Inc said it completed the sale of 600,000 shares of common stock for $11 a share in a private placement to Bellingham Industries Inc.
The deal, which raised gross proceeds of $6.6 million, increased Bellingham's stake to 1.87 million ProxyMed common shares, or a 17 percent stake in the healthcare information provider.
ProxyMed said in a statement on Monday that Bellingham has an option to buy an additional 100,000 shares by June 30, 1997, which could increase Bellingham's interest to 17.8 percent.
